description: Land Title Settlement Department - Keselwatta, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530022 (24/0925)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extent measurements, encumbrances, and legal interests. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land title settlement and property registration, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
